definitions.hard_boundary: A constitutional invariant or interaction distinction whose failure can change the governed runtime path, disclosure posture, data-admission posture, or execution containment applied to a request.
definitions.comparison_basis: Absolute case counts and semantic severity are primary. Rates are supporting evidence only.
definitions.tiny_denominator_rule: No percentage-only threshold is permitted when a frozen suite contains fewer than 100 relevant boundary cases.
definitions.single_case_materiality: One case is material when it is LEVEL_1_CONSTITUTIONAL or LEVEL_2_CRITICAL. One LEVEL_2_MAJOR case is material when the same transition family recurs in another independent frozen suite.

LEVEL_2_MAJOR.containment: Downstream fail-closed handling reduces severity from critical but does not make the classification correct or promotion-safe.

materiality_gate.promotion_rule: PASS requires zero Level 1, zero Level 2 Critical, no material Level 2 Major pattern, and all required evidence present. NOT_ASSERTABLE never promotes.

v0.2.reason: Preserved historical evidence supplies aggregate recall but not complete case-level transitions and containment evidence. Raw metrics remain unchanged.
